notes.title: 1.0.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
I want to again thank everyone who has played or streamed Toska!

Games are meant to be played, and getting to watch some of you discover Toska's secrets live on stream has been a real treat. This patch is relatively small, just fixing a few things I've noticed while watching the streams. One thing everyone seems to hate the inventory being bound to the "G" key. In development, I thought it made the most sense because it was close enough to the movement keys to be easy to reach, but not so close that you'd hit it by accident. You can now also use the "I" key to open/close the inventory, which is probably closer to a lot of people's muscle memory for games. 

Fixes and Adjustments:

[list]
[*]Can now use either "I" or "G" keys to open/close inventory.
[*]There was an infinitely respawning red squeeze bottle that has been removed.
[*]A journal entry was added to give more insight into the spawning of a specific character.
[*]The [spoiler]Wendigo in the caves[/spoiler] will now persist for the rest of the week after spawning.
[*]A sign was added to draw attention to an important room in the warehouse which was too easy to miss before.
[/list]

Stay awesome!

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 (a very small hotfix)
notes.content:
First, a very big thank you to everyone who's played so far. It truly means the world.

A few issues were noticed post-launch that will be patch-out or in with this update. See you on the next one!

[list]
[*]Some dialog options that the player doesn't have the prerequisites items to choose, will now still show in the response list but will be grayed out.
[*]Some "daily actions" items were missing, and have been added.
[*]Extra text was added to the description of a particular note.
[/list]

Hi-fives all around!
